clips.title: The story
paras: In the Valley of Trials, Hana'zua waits for help after Sarkoth's venom leaves him stranded. You have slain the scorpid that wounded him; now Gornek needs word at the Den so aid can reach the scout.

Hana'zua, a Darkspear scout, lies stranded on the high bluffs of the Valley of Trials. Sarkoth's venom has left him too weak to descend the treacherous paths alone. You have avenged him by slaying the scorpid, but he still cannot cross the arid stones without help. A passing initiate must carry word down to the training encampment.

Gornek waits at the Den for your report. Once he hears of Hana'zua's plight, he recognizes the danger from Sarkoth and organizes aid for the scout. Horde commanders honor those who set aside their own training to defend and rescue a fallen stranger. Such conduct proves an initiate's worth before they march into Durotar proper.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Seeing the deed you have done for me steels my heart. I cannot fall so easily! I must endure!
But it remains that I cannot make the trek back to the Den unassisted. Please, friend, return to the Den and tell Gornek of my situation. Perhaps he can help me.

clips.title: Completion
paras: From your description of the beast, I believe you must be speaking of Sarkoth! It is no wonder that Hana'zua was overtaken by it. Aid will be dispatched to him immediately, trouble yourself no more with Hana'zua's plight.

However, I must say, I am most impressed to hear that you brought Sarkoth to death. It is a feat to be proud of, friend. And that you would fight for a stranger's honor, while other tasks occupied your time, your own honor is heightened.
